deployment_note: Install both source modules together; policy imports the typed reason constant. Root is sole publisher; recheck latest actual module hashes before merge.
changes: CandidateRejected carries at most seven static rejection reason enums; no exception text parsing or source values exported
Same original validation predicates now report all failing categories; Store/worker/permission/transaction functions are AST-identical
Exact known board camera person-count event schema can render a compact count-only summary without LLM; no user speech, extra fields or unknown producer text accepted
Structured candidate still passes original full-source validation, claims/refs/cutoff/lease/generation checks and atomic Store commit; unsupported events use unchanged LLM path

structured_contract.limits: Exact existing producer sentences plus consistent integer numbers/claims; no extra metadata or claims; output must fit existing final summary capacity
structured_contract.narrative: Counts from typed sources in recording order; 0 means a sample did not detect a body; no arrival/departure/identity/continuous-presence claims

queue_findings.meaning: Identical task retry count; source selection prefers the maximum previous source attempt count, then age. No four-attempt discard or quarantine.
queue_findings.worker_wide_cooldown: Real failures delay every partition up to 60 seconds
queue_findings.different_partitions: Fewer-attempt groups can progress after cooldown; not a permanent global head-of-line lock
queue_findings.same_atomic_segment: A poison source can repeatedly retain a healthy companion; five synthetic attempts reproduce this without deleting either body

guarantees: No validation predicate removed or weakened
No premature body deletion or raw archive
Original same-boot generation fix, backoff, deadlines and source/permission guards preserved
limitations: Free-form LLM summaries still cannot be mechanically proven semantically lossless; rejected candidates stay pending
Queue scheduling and global backoff unchanged; residual poison batches may need a later separate remedy
Actual new rejection codes, eligible camera backlog size and postdeployment progress require root-only metadata

v13_problem_baseline.exact_v13_rejection_reason: Not recoverable from old four-field diagnostics; no model text was archived. New fixed enums reveal future rejections.
v13_problem_baseline.prior_wording_example: Synthetic source-derived camera wording can omit metadata numeral 0 and fail the original observation marker regex; this reproduces possible causes without claiming they were the six real responses.

comparison.note: Net queue change includes arrivals and any authorized mutations; report it alongside successful commits, not as an isolated throughput measurement.

root_deployment.overall: Structured camera publication and short-window net backlog reduction verified; all-library health, free-form summaries and backlog clearance not verified
